comment: jsaw-local corpus cases (DreamComp #42): the vendored corpus is DreamComp-generated and fingerprint-pinned; jsaw-only families (the ~ffi virtual module) live here and are merged at load time by the runners.

cases.name: ffi_callback_construct
cases.module: import { callback } from '~ffi'; export function run(x) { const C = callback('(i32) -> i32'); const b = C(function h(v) { return v + 1; }); return typeof b === 'object' && typeof C === 'function' ? x + 1 : 0; }

cases.name: ffi_contains_splice
cases.module: import { struct, contains } from '~ffi'; export function run(a) { const Bytes = struct('extern data: i32, len: i32'); const v = { x: a }; const T = contains(v); const S = struct(`extern header: i32, payload: ${T}, bytes: ${Bytes}`); const s = S(10, v, Bytes(2, 3)); return s.header + s.payload.x + s.bytes.len; }
